_comment: Weave preset - ontology. The governed vocabulary for a distributed AI dev team (Manager, Architect, Developer, Integrator). Extends the base methodology objects with the planning + code artifacts Weave produces (PRD, RFC, Diagram, PullRequest). Open-world: an unseen keyword is a warning, not an error.
name: weave

object_types.name: Role
object_types.description: A team role / principal: manager, architect, developer, integrator. Preset data, not core code.

object_types.name: ChangeRequest
object_types.description: A unit of requested change (CR-NNN). Opened by the Manager, designed by the Architect, delivered through Tasks.

object_types.name: Task
object_types.description: A technical task (TASK-NNN) that delivers part of a Change Request. Claimed by one Developer; moves through the coordination state machine.

object_types.name: ArchitectureDecisionRecord
object_types.description: An architecture/design decision (ADR) - the WHY behind a choice, including rejected options. Owned by the Architect.

object_types.name: Module
object_types.description: A source module / component of a project (a directory or package in the repo).

object_types.name: Commit
object_types.description: A git commit recorded against the project, linked to the modules it touched.

object_types.name: PRD
object_types.description: A Product Requirements Document authored by the Manager - the WHAT and WHY of a feature or change.

object_types.name: RFC
object_types.description: An architecture / technical design document authored by the Architect - the HOW.

object_types.name: Diagram
object_types.description: A mermaid diagram artifact for the project - authored visually or from text, versioned in the Studio ledger.

object_types.name: PullRequest
object_types.description: A pull request opened by a Developer for a completed Task - the code-in hand-back, reviewed before merge.

object_types.name: Worker
object_types.description: A registered dev worker in the live fleet - a headless Claude Code container loop or an interactive developer. Carries presence (heartbeat) and a control-state (run/pause/stop).

object_types.name: DevHost
object_types.description: A machine that carries autonomous developer containers. Registers itself and heartbeats outbound only - Weave never dials it - and reads back its control-state and the number of developers the team wants running there. Holds one shared Claude subscription seat, provisioned by an interactive login on the box.

object_types.name: Environment
object_types.description: The one long-lived shared integration environment where the assembled system runs. Owned by the Integrator; holds the declared config (ports, services, DB) and the live URL humans click.

object_types.name: IntegrationRun
object_types.description: A run of integration / e2e tests against the shared environment - the MERGE gate (distinct from a dev container's unit tests, which gate the PR). Green promotes a task to done; red blocks it.

link_types.name: assigned_to
link_types.description: A task is assigned to a role.

link_types.name: implements
link_types.description: A task implements part of a change request.

link_types.name: justified_by
link_types.description: A change request / task is justified by an architecture decision.

link_types.name: owns
link_types.description: A role owns / maintains a module.

link_types.name: depends_on
link_types.description: A module depends on another module.

link_types.name: touches
link_types.description: A commit or task touches one or more modules (used to serialise conflicting claims).

link_types.name: specifies
link_types.description: A PRD specifies a change request.

link_types.name: designs
link_types.description: An RFC designs a change request.

link_types.name: depicts
link_types.description: A diagram depicts a change request or module.

link_types.name: submitted_as
link_types.description: A task is submitted as a pull request.

link_types.name: reviewed_in
link_types.description: A pull request is reviewed, its outcome recorded as a decision.

link_types.name: implemented_by
link_types.description: A task is implemented by one or more commits.

link_types.name: registers
link_types.description: A role identity registers a worker into the fleet.

link_types.name: registers_host
link_types.description: A role identity registers a machine into the dev-host fleet.

link_types.name: supervises
link_types.description: A dev host supervises the developer containers running on it.

link_types.name: deployed_to
link_types.description: A task's work is deployed to the shared environment.

link_types.name: verifies
link_types.description: An integration run verifies a task in an environment (the merge gate).
